top_signals.title: How the Treasury got ‘fed up’ with the Bank of England’s payments plan
top_signals.summary: The government moved to more closely monitor the Bank of England’s overhaul of the UK’s payments system after growing frustrated with the sluggish pace of the plans, industry figures have said. The Treasury revealed last week it would begin tracking the central bank’s progress on payments and digital currencies by introducing a new secondary objective [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Over 900 Nepal students saved by call warning of flood and quick thinking
top_signals.summary: School's successful evacuation offers a rare glimmer of hope in a natural disaster that has killed over 900 people with thousands still missing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Shelter for families with children opens after Kumamoto earthquake
top_signals.summary: The specialized evacuation shelter, which also caters to the needs of pregnant women, is the only one of its kind in Kumamoto.
